title: TRICARE Select Card-Paid Installments: Part-Period Months and Whole Periods
content:
**Clause.** For a one-time card payment on a quarterly or annual **TRICARE Select** installment, the installment owed is set as follows. Where only one installment's coverage period has begun on the enrollment, so that it is the enrollment's first, and the enrollment took effect after the first month of that installment's calendar period, the installment owed is one twelfth of the annual fee for each month from the month containing the effective date through the end of the period; where the enrollment ended before the last month of the installment period that contains its last day of coverage, it is one twelfth of the annual fee for each month from the start of that period through the month containing the last day of coverage, that month counted whole; otherwise it is the annual fee for the whole period, one quarter of it for a quarterly installment and all of it for an annual one; each figure is rounded to the cent.

The cases are taken in the order written: the first-installment case, then the ended-enrollment case, then the whole period. A month is a calendar month and one twelfth of the annual fee is the annual fee divided by 12; the installment period is the calendar quarter or the calendar year, as the installments are quarterly or annual. An enrollment has ended when its status is disenrolled voluntarily, disenrolled for nonpayment, terminated as ineligible or transferred out, whatever the payment date; its last day of coverage is then the disenrollment date on its record.

## Judgement table

| Situation on the payment date | Months owed |
|---|---|
| only the first installment has begun, effective after the period's first month | from the effective month through the end of the period |
| enrollment ended before the last month of the period containing its last day of coverage | from the start of that period through the month of the last day of coverage |
| any other case | the whole period (3 months for a quarter, 12 for a year) |

## Worked cases (hypothetical, family annual fee 1190.16)

| Case | Months | Installment owed |
|---|---|---|
| quarterly, first and only installment, effective 2026-05-20 | May and June: 2 | 198.36 |
| quarterly, first and only installment, effective 2026-04-15 (April is the quarter's first month) | whole quarter: 3 | 297.54 |
| quarterly, last day of coverage 2026-08-14 | July and August: 2 | 198.36 |
| quarterly, last day of coverage 2026-09-30 (September is the quarter's last month) | whole quarter: 3 | 297.54 |
| annual, first and only installment, effective 2026-03-01 | March to December: 10 | 991.80 |
